script.speaker: roxy
script.text: S.O.S. the coffee machine at my internship made a noise like a dying goose and quit

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: cafe lunch. today. i need a real coffee and actual food or i'm not making it to 5!!

script.speaker: mina
script.text: roxy, are you okay?? that sounds like a rough morning

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: mina!! our first lunch together since campus. i've missed you

script.speaker: mina
script.text: me too! summer has been so busy. brooke, how's the new office treating you?

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: a whole week of birthday cake, that's how. so today's lunch has to be the wholesome, actually-good-for-you kind

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: A whole week of cake. I'm impressed, and a little concerned.

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Mina, I'll do what I did on sushi day: find you a whole section with zero meat in it.

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ooh and i'll read every board for you, cyrus. no satay incident sequel today!!

script.speaker: mina
script.text: roxy, that's sweet :) read them for yourself too, though: half a cafe menu is milk, butter or cheese, and your stomach still isn't speaking to any of them

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ...ok, fair. mina, you just saved my whole afternoon

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Roxy, before we go: I'd like the full goose report.

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: it went out with a bang and a puff of steam. the whole floor clapped

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: assistant, you're up. do it for the goose
